question: 5 students are randomly selected from 50 students by drawing lots. What is the probability that each student is selected? (Write the answer as a fraction in simplest form.)
solution: Drawing lots gives all 50 students the same chance of selection. Since 5 students are selected, each student's probability is the fraction of the group selected: \(5\div50=1/10\).
